Name: Tantei Portraitures by Sheepfty
Author: Shweepfty
Description:
I currently installed Shie's work into my Smapi and Tantei had been the only one with no Shie styled art so... 

My first time making a Portraiture mod, take the portraits with a grain of salt as I don't really know Tantei yet.

How to use the mod: (Android guide)

1.Install Portraiture
2. Pick a zip set (Only one set can be enabled)
3. Add the pngs into the current active folder in Portraiture.

Downloads.Description:
Changes:
- Made the portraits head to be centered
- Slot 2 expression to be more of a smile instead of a over high smile
- Slot 6 expression to be more annoyed than blank face (Take with grain of salt as my only basis for changing this is the summer dia)
The actual Shie style, Pick inbetween Sheepfty Hybrid or Shie style.
